title: 第17章 一把邪剑第18章 卖符篆的少年
content_zh:
张逸风这句话一出，赵龙的表情才变得认真了一点，以前的张逸风，他可是一清二楚，肯定没有现在这么厉害，但不知道发生了什么现在的张逸风一人打三人还显得轻轻松松。但尽管有些相信，他还是问了一句：“这套拳法真的能让我变厉害？”
张逸风肯定地点了点头：“只要你肯努力练，其中厉害程度，你想都不想到。”
这一套炼体拳法，如果赵龙真的掌握，并且将之圆满，怕是能相当于练气期的高手。这修为灵月大陆不算什么，但在地球绝对是一代传奇。
“好，只要一有空我就会练习，如果真的能让我变得厉害，那就再好不过了。”
赵龙双眼射出一道光芒，因为身材弱小，他经常被欺负，但如果他变得强大，他就不需要忌惮、畏惧谁。他真的不想成为敢怒不敢言的懦夫！
赵龙此刻还意识不到，就是这样一个两块钱的笔记本，却成了赵家的传家之宝——《赵家拳法总纲》。今后赵家成为武道世家，从此代代传承，就凭借这一本丢在地上都不会有人捡的笔记。
“嗯，你先看一遍，然后我教你标准作出前面三个姿势。”
“三个姿势？今日只练习三个姿势吗？”
“不是今日，是未来三个月甚至更久。”
“啊？”
赵龙有些发懵，张逸风画的小人，没有一百也有八十，三个月才练三个姿势，将姿势全部掌握，那不是要花费几年时间？
摇了摇头，赵龙开始仔细观看前面三个姿势，自己尝试了一下之后，他才明白为何张逸风那样说了。
这三个姿势看上去简单，但每一个细节，都能带动整个身体的肌肉和经脉，他能感觉到身体肌肉拉扯一般地疼痛，好像会连同经脉一起扯断一般。这种感觉，一般人根本承受不了。
“你是不是觉得很痛？那是因为你的动作不标准，所以你才这么痛，现在按照我说的做。”
张逸风的声音传来，开始亲自教赵龙联系前三个姿势。
时间流逝，天色逐渐变得黝黑，整整一下午的时间，赵龙终于能做出第一个姿势了。
赵龙此刻有种诡异的感觉，他全身的力量随着这个姿势的做出似乎都集中在了右拳之前，只要他一拳击出，就能拥有不可思议的力量。
但，他根本挥不出拳头，这简单的动作，似乎要抽空他全身的力量。拳头未出，他就已经倒在了地上。
这不知道是他多少次倒地了，但赵龙性格还算坚毅，倒了就会站起来。
“行了，今天的练习就到这里，你的身体再练习下去，反而没有好处。”

张逸风的声音传来，制止了赵龙继续练习。
“嗯，我知道了。”

赵龙全身被汗水浸湿，但他没有喊累，反而眼神变得越来越炙热，他现在相信张逸风的话了，这套拳法肯定能让他变得厉害！他感觉他全身肌肉都在受到淬炼。
“你休息一会自己回去吧，我有事情要出去一趟。”
天色已黑，张逸风该去珍宝园了。现在的他，严重缺钱。话落，张逸风拿起放在床头的一个小箱子和一面裹起来的布旗帜，随后便离开了寝室。
叫了一辆车，二十分钟后，张逸风抵达了珍宝园。
珍宝园处于市中心一处偏僻的地下室，知道这里的人都非富即贵，当然也有一些有家传之宝的穷苦人，想要这里碰碰运气，将自己的东西卖个好价钱。
张逸风身穿一身运动衣，带着一个墨镜，缴纳了八百元门票钱，便直接进入了珍宝园。
珍宝园里没有多少规矩，任何人只要给了门票钱，就可以进入，如果有好东西也可以拿来卖。园方不收取任何费用。因为八百元的门票钱，已经不低了。每天进入珍宝园的，来来去去怎么也有数百人，再加上贩卖一些酒水饮料，甜点食品，小小的珍宝园收入还是不菲。
张逸风没有马上摆摊售卖自己炼制的符篆，而是在珍宝园里逛了一圈。
“嗯？”
忽然，张逸风在一个售卖古玩的摊贩上停下了。他的目光放在一件看上去很久远的青铜古剑之上，摊贩的主人是一个大约四十岁的中年男子，西装革履，英堂发黑，略显纤瘦。
见有人询问这把剑，中年男子立马双眼放光：“这位小兄弟，看上这把剑了吗？这可是春秋战国时代的青铜战剑。要不是家里缺钱，我也不会卖，一口价八十万。这价格已经很低了，春秋时期的青铜剑，最少的也能拍卖百万以上。”
张逸风看了一下剑，眉头微微一皱，这把剑蕴含诡异的气息，似乎里面有什么不详的东西。
张逸风摸了摸剑，翻来覆去仔细研究了一下上面的符文雕刻，张逸风确定这是一把鬼剑。
这发现让张逸风非常惊讶，地球居然会出现鬼剑，说明许多年前，地球的确有修士，鬼剑正是邪恶修者所打造的配剑，此剑杀人之后，能吸收人的灵魂和怨气，杀的人越多，怨气和邪念越重。如果修者压制不了剑的邪念，就会被剑反噬，成为所谓的杀人狂魔。
鬼剑，也就是不详之剑。
知道这是什么剑，张逸风淡淡道：“如果我是你，我就不会想着将这把剑卖一个好价钱，早些将这把剑扔了把，它不会给你带来任何好运，反而会让你倾家荡产，甚至会给你带来杀生之祸，这是一把不详之剑。”
闻言，中年脸色一变，却咬牙道：“你不买就不要乱说。别影响我做买卖。”

张逸风摇了摇头，道：“我是不是乱说，你自己比我更清楚，我想你也是近期才得到这把剑的，得到这把剑之后，你的处境变得怎样，你自己想一想。这把剑，只要稍微懂一点门道的，都不会买。”
张逸风没有多说什么，转身便离开了。这把剑他其实想要，但他没有钱买，而且他确信中年卖不出去。除非遇到了不懂考古的门外汉。
content_en:
As soon as Zhang Yifeng said these words, Zhao Long's expression became a little more serious. He knew clearly about the Zhang Yifeng in the past. He was definitely not as powerful as he is now, but he didn't know what happened. Now Zhang Yifeng seemed to be able to fight three people easily. But even though he believed a little, he still asked: "Can this boxing technique really make me stronger?"
Zhang Yifeng nodded affirmatively: "As long as you are willing to practice hard, you can never imagine how powerful it will be."
If Zhao Long really mastered this body-refining boxing technique and perfected it, he would probably be comparable to a master in the Qi-training stage. This level of cultivation in Lingyue Continent is nothing, but it is definitely a legend on Earth.
"Okay, I will practice whenever I have time. If it really makes me become better, that would be great."
Zhao Long's eyes shone with light. Because of his weak stature, he was often bullied, but if he became strong, he would not need to be afraid of anyone. He really doesn't want to become a coward who dares to be angry but dare not speak out!
Zhao Long didn't realize it at the moment, but just such a two-dollar notebook had become a heirloom of the Zhao family - "The General Principle of Zhao Family Boxing". From now on, the Zhao family will become a martial arts family, and it will be passed down from generation to generation, relying on this notebook that no one will pick up even if it is thrown on the ground.
"Well, you look at it first, and then I teach you how to make the first three postures in a standard way."
"Three postures? Do you only practice three postures today?"
"Not today, but in the next three months or even longer."
"Huh?"
Zhao Long was a little confused. The villains painted by Zhang Yifeng ranged from 100 to 80. It only took three months to practice three postures and master all the postures. Wouldn't it take several years?
Shaking his head, Zhao Long began to look at the first three postures carefully. After trying it himself, he understood why Zhang Yifeng said that.
These three postures seem simple, but every detail can activate the muscles and meridians of the entire body. He can feel the pain of pulling the muscles in his body, as if they will be torn off along with the meridians. Most people simply cannot bear this feeling.
"Do you feel pain? That's because your movements are not standard, that's why you feel so much pain. Now do as I say."
Zhang Yifeng's voice came and he began to personally teach Zhao Long the first three postures.
Time passed and the sky gradually turned dark. After a whole afternoon, Zhao Long was finally able to make his first gesture.
Zhao Long had a strange feeling at this moment. With this gesture, all his strength seemed to be concentrated in front of his right fist. As long as he punched out, he would have incredible power.
However, he couldn't swing his fist at all. This simple movement seemed to drain all the strength from his body. Before his fist could be released, he fell to the ground.
I don’t know how many times he fell to the ground, but Zhao Long’s character is still strong and he will stand up when he falls.
"Okay, that's it for today's practice. It won't do your body any good if you practice any more."
Zhang Yifeng's voice came and stopped Zhao Long from continuing to practice.
"Well, I understand."

Zhao Long's whole body was soaked with sweat, but he did not cry out that he was tired. Instead, his eyes became hotter and hotter. He now believed Zhang Yifeng's words. This boxing technique would definitely make him powerful! He felt that all the muscles in his body were being tempered.
"You can rest for a while and go back by yourself. I have something to go out on."
It's getting dark now, it's time for Zhang Yifeng to go to Zhenbao Garden. Now he is seriously short of money. After saying this, Zhang Yifeng picked up a small box and a wrapped cloth flag placed on the bedside, and then left the dormitory.
After hailing a car, Zhang Yifeng arrived at Zhenbao Garden twenty minutes later.
Treasure Garden is located in a remote basement in the city center. We know that the people here are either rich or noble. Of course, there are also some poor people who have family heirlooms and want to try their luck here and sell their things.West sold for a good price.
Zhang Yifeng was wearing a sportswear and sunglasses, paid the 800 yuan entrance fee, and entered the Treasure Garden directly.
There are not many rules in the treasure garden. Anyone can enter as long as they pay the entrance fee. If they have good things, they can also sell them. The park does not charge any fees. Because the ticket price of 800 yuan is already quite high. There are hundreds of people coming and going every day in the Zhenbao Garden. In addition to selling some drinks and desserts, the small Zhenbao Garden still earns a lot of money.
Zhang Yifeng did not immediately set up a stall to sell the talismans he refined, but took a walk around the treasure garden.
"Huh?"
Suddenly, Zhang Yifeng stopped at a stall selling antiques. His eyes were fixed on an ancient bronze sword that seemed to be from ancient times. The owner of the stall was a middle-aged man about forty years old, wearing a suit and leather shoes, with a dark figure and a slightly slim appearance.
Seeing someone asking about this sword, the middle-aged man's eyes immediately shone: "Little brother, have you fallen in love with this sword? This is a bronze war sword from the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period. If my family hadn't been short of money, I wouldn't have sold it. The price is 800,000. This price is already very low. A bronze sword from the Spring and Autumn Period can be auctioned for more than one million yuan."
Zhang Yifeng looked at the sword and frowned slightly. This sword contained a strange aura, as if there was something ominous in it.
Zhang Yifeng touched the sword, turned it over and carefully studied the rune carvings on it, and Zhang Yifeng was sure that it was a ghost sword.
This discovery made Zhang Yifeng very surprised. The ghost sword actually appeared on the earth, which shows that many years ago, there were indeed monks on the earth. The ghost sword was a matching sword made by evil cultivators. After killing people, this sword can absorb people's souls and resentment. The more people they kill, the heavier the resentment and evil thoughts will be. If the cultivator cannot suppress the evil thoughts of the sword, he will be backlashed by the sword and become a so-called murderer.
The ghost sword is the sword of unknown origin.
Knowing what kind of sword it was, Zhang Yifeng said calmly: "If I were you, I wouldn't think about selling this sword for a good price. I would have thrown this sword away earlier. It will not bring you any good luck. Instead, it will bankrupt you and even bring disaster to you. This is an ominous sword."
Hearing this, the middle-aged man's face changed, but he gritted his teeth and said: "If you don't buy it, don't talk nonsense. Don't affect my business."
Zhang Yifeng shook his head and said: "Am I talking nonsense? You know better than me. I think you only got this sword recently. After getting this sword, you can think about what your situation will be like. No one who knows a little bit about this sword will buy it."
Zhang Yifeng didn't say anything more, turned around and left. He actually wanted the sword, but he didn't have the money to buy it, and he was sure he couldn't sell it in his middle age. Unless you meet a layman who doesn't understand archeology.
